title: Disposal Services for Medical Chemical Defense Materiel
description:
This is a new enterprise requirement and there are no incumbents.  

  

 See attached document(s) for full information. 

  

  Submission:  Email responses to Contract Specialist abraham.g.pottenger.civ@health.mil and Contracting Officer randy.o.barry2.civ@health.mil 

  

 2.0 Scope of Work Summary 

 The Government requires a contractor to provide all personnel, equipment, facilities, and compliant materials for the secure collection, and destruction of hazardous and non-hazardous MCDM, from Military Treatment Facilities (MTFs) across Continental United States (CONUS), Alaska, Hawaii, and Outside the Continental United States (OCONUS). 

 2.1 Key Requirements 

 
	  Logistics:  Provide all Department of Transportation (DOT)/Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) compliant shipping supplies (containers, liners, manifests) to government sites. MTFs will collect and package materials for destruction in contractor provided containers. 
	  Secure Disposal and DEA Compliance:  Perform DEA compliant receipt, storage, and destruction of Schedule II–V controlled substances and MCDM at a licensed CONUS-based facility. Perform DEA and host-nation compliant receipt, storage, and destruction of Schedule II–V controlled substances and MCDM at an authorized OCONUS-based facility, or coordinate secure export to a licensed CONUS-based facility in accordance with international transport regulations. 
	  Regulatory Adherence:  Maintain strict adherence to all DEA, EPA, DOT, FDA, other applicable federal and state regulations, and international regulations and transport treaties. 
	  Reporting:  Provide Certificates of Destruction within 30 days of disposal and submit comprehensive monthly disposal reports. Maintain an online tracking portal for real-time shipment status and monthly disposal reports.
